{
  "thinking": "Empty table, round just started, and the pad is free. I'll take it and sketch a fish: a body outline from the start, a forked tail, and an eye. The outline alone should read as a fish.",
  "say": "Let's do a fish! Its tail fin and body outline should read well from the fall. I've got the pad and I'm sketching it now. Shout if you want the tail a different shape.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 7,
  "point": [8, 13],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[8, 13], [14, 13.5], [20, 13], [22.5, 10], [20, 7.5], [14, 6.5], [8, 7.5]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[8, 7.5], [4, 4], [6, 10], [4, 16], [8, 12.5]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 18, "y": 9.5, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "sketch_clear": false,
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Animal: fish. Stroke 1 = body outline from START (bottom near tail) going right along bottom, round nose, back along top. Stroke 2 = forked tail branching from top-back end of stroke 1, down to a notch, ending near the start side. Plan: trace stroke 1 first, then 2. Pad is with me."
}
